summary: Open TCP 27199 with firewall-cmd if receptor_listener_port is set, run ansible-playbook -i inventory.yml install_receptor.yml (needs OpenSSL), and note that in a control plane only some nodes listen on 27199 because connections are one-way initiated.
questions: How do I run the install_receptor.yml playbook?
Which firewall port does receptor use?
Why is controller node A not listening on port 27199?

answer_card.title: Install a node from the bundle
answer_card.answer_md:
```
sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --add-port=27199/tcp
sudo dnf install -y openssl   # if missing
ansible-playbook -i inventory.yml install_receptor.yml
```

After the playbook runs the node is part of the mesh. Not every control node listens on 27199: the one that initiates all peer connections has nothing connecting to it.
